requirements.quoted_text: Assignment 1: research summary
insight list
Pinterest mood board
Every brief must trace back to a specific research finding, insight, or mood-board pin from Assignment 1.

This assignment doesn't start from a blank page. It starts from Assignment 1 — your research summary, your insight list, and your Pinterest mood board. Every brief you write here has to trace back to something you already found or decided in that assignment. If a choice in this assignment can't be justified by a specific research finding, a specific insight, or a specific pin on your board, it's a guess dressed up as a decision — and it should be reworked until it isn't. The point of this assignment: in the real world, nobody designs directly from a mood board. Someone writes a brief first — a document precise enough that a photographer, a designer, or an AI tool could pick it up and actually produce the right thing without you standing over their shoulder. You're going to write three of those.

Not one long document — three separate, focused briefs, each doing a different job: - Brand Idea & Philosophy Brief — what this brand believes and stands for - Product & Packaging Brief — what the actual product is and how it presents itself - Ad/Campaign Creative Brief — how this brand shows up in a campaign, and what it takes to actually produce that Note: Think of them as three documents you could hand to three different people — a strategist, a packaging designer, and a director — and each would know exactly what to do.

requirements.quoted_text: This is the one that will actually get produced — treat it like a real production document.

For each of the three briefs, answer in one line: which specific research finding, insight, or mood-board pin does this trace back to? If you can't answer that for a major decision in any brief, go back and fix it — this is the check that keeps the whole assignment from becoming three disconnected documents.
Submit all three briefs as one package, clearly labeled, plus the one-line coherence answers above each brief.
Traceability: Every major decision across all three briefs connects to something specific from Assignment 1
Specificity: Briefs are precise enough that someone else could execute from them without guessing
Internal consistency: The brand philosophy, the packaging, and the campaign all feel like they belong to the same brand
Production realism: The production requirements are genuinely achievable, or a genuinely thought-through AI-generation path
Differentiation: The direction has a specific point of view — it doesn't read like a generic version of the category leader
